title: Crime
description: Centres on criminal activity, law enforcement, and moral ambiguity. Focus on investigation, perpetrators, or victims.

title: Heist
description: Planning and executing a complex theft with a specialist crew and ticking-clock jeopardy.

title: Film Noir
description: Dark and cynical crime with chiaroscuro lighting and flawed anti-heroes.

title: Thriller
description: Suspense-driven narratives built around jeopardy, pursuit, and reversals.

title: Action-Thriller
description: Combines physical action set pieces with thriller suspense and stakes.

title: Action
description: Spectacle and kinetic set pieces foregrounded over introspection.

title: Romance
description: Focus on relationships, emotional stakes, and fulfilment or loss.

title: Romantic Comedy
description: Humour plus romance with a light tone and cyclical misunderstandings.

title: Horror
description: Designed to provoke fear or dread through threat, the uncanny, or the monstrous.

title: Slasher
description: Stalk-and-slash threat against a group, often teens, with iconic killer imagery.

title: Psychological Horror
description: Internalised fear and unreliable perception rather than overt monsters.

title: Science Fiction
description: Speculative ideas grounded in science or technology.

title: Cyberpunk
description: High-tech, low-life futures with corporate power and identity crises.

title: Fantasy
description: Magic or mythic elements in alternative or heightened worlds.

title: Western
description: Frontier settings with law, justice, and landscape as moral stage.
icon_example_title: The Good the Bad and the Ugly

title: Space Western
description: Western tropes transposed into space-opera settings.

title: Documentary
description: Non-fiction narratives presenting actuality with rhetorical shaping.

title: Mockumentary
description: Fiction presented in documentary style for satire or realism.

title: Superhero
description: Extraordinary protagonists with powers or tech who pursue justice.

title: Animation
description: Stories realised through frame-by-frame or computer-generated imagery.

title: Music Video
description: Short form visual accompaniment to a track, often performance plus concept.

title: Action Game
description: Interactive focus on reflex challenges and combat.
